parameters.name: GIpList
parameters.description:
The IP addresses in the whitelist template.

> Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,). You can add a total of up to 1,000 IP addresses or CIDR blocks to all IP whitelists.

parameters.name: GlobalIgName
parameters.description:
The name of the IP whitelist template. The name must meet the following requirements:

- It can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (\_).

- It must start with a letter and end with a letter or digit.

- It must be 2 to 120 characters in length.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.
